'''Junction 206-994''' was a [[slidewalk]] junction on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] of [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Work shifts would embark and disembark from the junction. Near the junction was one of the few patches of soil left on Metalorn. [[Tammia Hollusen]] was determined to grow [[Plant/Legends|plants]] in the nutrient-depleted soil there.
